gaps.sentence: ___ Smith family have lived in this street since 1990.
gaps.explanation: 'The Smith family' — the whole family takes 'the'.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ heir to a shipping fortune.
gaps.explanation: 'Heir' begins with a vowel sound — the h is silent.

gaps.sentence: She earns fifty pounds ___ hour as a consultant.
gaps.explanation: 'An hour' — the 'h' is silent, so it starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
The tour included ___ visit to the British Museum.
gaps.explanation: 'A visit' (one of many possible) and 'the British Museum' (museums take 'the').

gaps.sentence: He was ___ last person to leave the building.
gaps.explanation: Ordinals take 'the': the last person, the first time.

gaps.sentence: She works as ___ waitress during the summer holidays.
gaps.explanation: After 'as' and 'work as', jobs take a/an: work as a waitress.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.
